notes.title: 1.04 Update: Bugfixes and Soundtrack
notes.content:
[b]Soundtrack:[/b]

This update finally adds the long-promised soundtrack. You can find it by going to the "Music" category in your Steam Library and searching for Tesla: The Weather Man. If you'd like to listen to it outside of Steam, just click the "Show in System" link to get to the MP3 files.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed a crash that could occur during respawn or level loading
[*] Fixed a crash on startup when tutorials are disabled
[*] Other minor fixes[/list]
[b]Why did this take so long?[/b]

At the moment, Thoughtquake Studios LLC is a one-man company. It has never made enough money to provide a livable income, so it's been on the backburner while I focused on my day job. That's changing now, as I'm once again risking my savings to focus on game development full-time. Most of my time will be going toward a new game, but there will be more updates to Tesla: The Weather Man in the near future.
